version.changelog:
- 初始版本发布，支持通过城市名查询当前天气。
- 返回简洁中文信息，包含城市、天气状况和温度。
- 自动处理中文和英文城市名输入，并提供失败提示。

llm.summary: This instruction-only skill simply queries the public wttr.in service for a city's current weather and its requirements and instructions are consistent with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (查询城市当前天气) match the content of SKILL.md. The skill requests no credentials, binaries, or config paths that would be unrelated to fetching weather.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions tell the agent to call the third-party API wttr.in (example: curl "wttr.in/Shanghai?format=3"). This is expected for a weather query skill, but it does cause the agent to perform external network requests that transmit the provided city name and the agent's IP to wttr.in.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files are present (instruction-only), so nothing is written to disk or installed at runtime.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no environment variables or credentials and the instructions do not reference any secrets—proportional to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable only. It does not request persistent system presence or modify other skills/configurations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is small and coherent: it will make simple HTTP requests to the public wttr.in service and return a one- or two-sentence Chinese weather summary. Before installing, consider: (1) privacy — queries (city names) and your agent's IP will be visible to wttr.in and may be logged; (2) availability — the skill relies on an external free service (rate limits or downtime possible); and (3) if you need stronger privacy or reliability, use a dedicated weather API with your own API key or an internal data source instead. The extra text file in the package appears harmless. If you want lower network exposure, do not enable autonomous invocation for the agent or restrict network access.
